notes.content: prerequisites for admission to the option

Students who declare themselves an art major in the Department of Art and Art History are placed in the BA program. After completion of the lower division option requirements below, students may apply for admission into the BFA, and in most instances, they will be able to apply their lower division Art (ARTS) and Art History (ARTH) coursework towards the BFA requirements. Advisors will clarify receiving credits toward the BFA. It is advisable to have taken upper division art studio courses in the area of your emphasis before applying to the BFA in Art Studio Option. A GPA of 3.0 or higher (in the major) is needed to apply to the program. Admission to the program is determined by a portfolio review. Students in the BFA Art Studio Option must maintain a GPA of 3.0 (in the major) in order to remain in the program.

  5. Admission to the program is determined by a portfolio review.

notes.content: The Art Studio Option has an upper division requirement where a student selects an Art Studio Emphasis. Students must select a single emphasis from the following groups: Ceramics Digital Media Drawing Glass Design Painting Photography Printmaking Sculpture The courses listed in the Art Studio Emphasis Prerequisite Courses section below serve as prerequisite courses to the upper division Art Studio Emphasis courses. The student should carefully select these prerequisite courses based on the Art Studio Emphasis of choice. Please see the University Catalog for the upper division course listings as well as the full listing of degree requirements.
notes.contentHtml:
The Art Studio Option has an upper division requirement where a student selects an Art Studio Emphasis. Students must select a single emphasis from the following groups:

  • Ceramics
  • Digital Media
  • Drawing
  • Glass Design
  • Painting
  • Photography
  • Printmaking
  • Sculpture


The courses listed in the Art Studio Emphasis Prerequisite Courses section below serve as prerequisite courses to the upper division Art Studio Emphasis courses. The student should carefully select these prerequisite courses based on the Art Studio Emphasis of choice. Please see the University Catalog for the upper division course listings as well as the full listing of degree requirements.

notes.content: Students interested in the Photography emphasis are required to take ARTS 240 and ARTS 241 as two of the three courses listed in the Art Studio Emphasis Prerequisite Courses section below.
